title: Concept: Third-party script without an integrity check
description: A script from another origin with no integrity attribute in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Without a hash the browser runs whatever the third party serves at that moment, so a compromise of the CDN becomes a compromise of the banking session.
applicability: Deployments that render a script from another origin with no integrity attribute into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Without a hash the browser runs whatever the third party serves at that moment, so a compromise of the CDN becomes a compromise of the banking session.
